pairs.difference: A: the big pumpkin turns from light to shadow in a slow, even gradient with only a dim shadow side at lower right; the ribs are soft and carry no real highlight, and the lens reads as even clay. shading_range 0.847 is above the real band. Its blue-green cast shadow at right is a blurry pool. B: the topiary tiers have a bright upper-left light side falling to a deep dark underside on every tier, and a clear directional cast shadow runs right on the grass. All B fields are in band.
pairs.fix: Light the pumpkins from the upper left with one clear light side and a darker core shadow on the lower right of each pumpkin, a small soft sheen on the top of each rib, and a tighter, darker contact shadow where they touch the grass.

pairs.difference: A: the cooler has a lit top rim and lid interior, a side plane that drops clearly, and a soft cast shadow sliding left across the sand, with form_contrast 0.514 in band. B: the lion and plinth are nearly evenly lit pale marble, with shallow shadow in the mane and little drop on the plinth's side faces; form_contrast 0.331 is below the real band, and the lens looks close to the delivered color.
pairs.fix: Give the lion a darker shadow side on the far flank and under the mane, make the plinth's side faces clearly darker than its top, and add a dark contact shadow where the steps meet the grass.

pairs.difference: A: the bat body is a soft ball with almost no direction to the light, and the wings are shaded symmetrically left and right with a thin dark edge all round. form_contrast 0.269 and light_bias_strength 0.067 are both below the real band. No side reads as lit. B: the envelope and photos have soft but readable folds, a lighter upper flap and a shaded edge, and form_contrast 0.429 is in band.
pairs.fix: Light the bat from the upper left: brighter top of head and left wing, the body falling into a clear shadow at lower right, the right wing darker than the left, with a small soft sheen on the head.

pairs.difference: A: the shoes have crisp planes, a tight dark contact line and a firm long cast shadow to the left, so the light direction is easy to read, though light_bias_strength 0.019 is oddly low and range 0.82 slightly high. B: the cauldron belly is an airbrushed dark gradient with a broad vague sheen and a teal patch of bounce, with no defined highlight, and the green liquid does not light the rim. light_bias_strength 0.761 is above the band.
pairs.fix: Add one small, soft highlight high on the left of the cauldron's shoulder, make the core shadow a clear band on the right of the belly, and let the green liquid throw a faint glow on the inside of the rim.

pairs.difference: A: the lamp dome has a clear lit top and a darker lower side with a narrow bright reflection along the arm, but form_contrast 0.68 is above the band, partly from dark metal against a pale ground. B: the flames glow yet the wax and gold arms barely pick up warm light from them; the gold is broad and even, and the base underside is a flat black band. Fields are in band, so this rests on my eye only.
pairs.fix: Let each flame spill warm light on the top of its candle and on the nearest cup, and fade that glow downward; give the gold arms a darker underside with a thin warm reflected edge.

pairs.difference: A: leaves throw hard dappled cast shadows across the blue door, and panels have a lit edge and a dark inset, all from a single upper-left source. B: the house walls are close to the same mid-dark on both sides with no clear key side; the windows are saturated self-lit yellow with little spill on the surrounding stone, and form_contrast 0.607 is just above the band.
pairs.fix: Pick one side of the house as the sunlit side and make the walls there clearly brighter, cast roof shadows down the walls, and let each window throw a soft warm glow onto its stone frame.

pairs.difference: A: the gravestone front is an even matte grey with a soft dark side at right, shallow chiseled edges, and a blurry oval cast shadow; form_contrast 0.393 is just below the band. B: the slide has sharp shifts from white lit trough to deep navy outer wall, and the posts throw clear shadows on the deck, though light_bias_strength 0.149 is low.
pairs.fix: Brighten the top-left face of the stone, deepen the right side into a firm core shadow, cut crisp dark shadow into the cross on one side and a lit edge on the other, and give the cast shadow a darker edge at the base.

pairs.difference: A: the crystal ball reads as a nearly blank sphere in the lens, with one small streak highlight at upper right and a soft flat stand; shading_range 0.537 and form_contrast 0.372 are both below the band. Transparent glass may understate this in the lens. The shadow under the stand is faint. B: the vending machine has a bright top and front edge, a dark left side, a soft floor glow and a contact shadow, with all fields in band.
pairs.fix: Give the ball a bright curved window highlight at upper left, a darker lower rim with a thin warm bounce edge, sharper bright and dark sides on the metal stand, and a firmer shadow under its feet.

pairs.difference: A: the mower has sharp highlights on the red hood, cool shadow under the body, warm bounce on the wheel faces, and strong range at 0.875. B: the broom bristles are a single soft brown mass with a shallow turn and only an even dark cast shadow to the right; form_contrast 0.391 is below the band and light_bias_strength 1.561 is far above it, likely driven by the dark wall against the lit floor.
pairs.fix: Make the upper-left bristles catch bright light and drop the lower right into dark shadow, add dark gaps between bristle clumps, a small sheen along the handle, and a tight dark contact line at the floor.

pairs.difference: A: the coffin lid is a broad soft gradient and the lens stays warm all over like the base color; the side is simply darker, and the edge sheen is a uniform line. form_contrast 0.352 is below the band. B: the chair has crisp light and shadow on rails and rockers, a dark underside to the seat, and floor shadows and reflections under the rockers, with all fields in band.
pairs.fix: Make the lid's near corner bright and fall off toward the far end, darken the long side into a clean plane with a lighter bevel on top, and add a dark contact shadow along the base with a soft shadow across the floor.

pairs.difference: A: the pumpkin is very smoothly modeled with a broad soft turn, no crisp highlight, and flat yellow glow in the carved shapes that does not fall off on the carved walls; shading_range 0.855 is above the band. B: the jacket has dark folds, a soft shadow side and small highlights on the badges, with all fields in band, though the lens is tinted by the green ground. The call is close.
pairs.fix: Add small soft highlights on the ribs at upper left, and make the glow brightest deep inside the carved face and fade it across the carved edges into dark orange.

pairs.difference: A: the towel is flat with soft blurry fold shadows and no contact shadow; shading_range 0.494 sits just below the band, but a flat cloth naturally has little form, and floating real cards also skip the cast shadow. B: the coral has a glossy sheen on the tips and a warm glow behind it, with all fields in band. Neither card shows a clear lighting fault.

pattern: Generated cards still model form with a broad, slow, even gradient, while real cards have one committed light side, a firm core shadow and a clearly darker shadow side. Common giveaways are low form_contrast with no clear light direction (bat, lion, gravestone, coffin), soft vague sheen in place of a placed highlight, self-lit glows that do not spill onto nearby surfaces (candles, windows, carved pumpkin), and blurry cast shadows without a tight contact line. Caveat: many pairs split horror subject versus everyday subject, so close calls may carry that bias. Transparent glass and strong background color also distort the lens readings.
